subject.title: fix: harden recovered meeting browser sessions

question: Should recovered talk-back sessions remain blocked until browser health explicitly reports `micMuted: false`?
rationale: This is a user-visible compatibility choice between fail-closed protection against unverified speech delivery and permissive readiness for browsers that omit microphone-state telemetry. The PR records the intended choice, but the protected maintainer label requires normal human review.

options.title: Accept verified-only readiness
options.body: Merge with unknown microphone state remaining transiently blocked until browser health explicitly reports an unmuted microphone.

options.title: Preserve permissive readiness
options.body: Keep the prior microphone-readiness behavior and limit this PR to transcript and tab-recovery fixes until a separate policy direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept verified-only readiness
recommendation.body: Merge with unknown microphone state remaining transiently blocked until browser health explicitly reports an unmuted microphone.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the meeting-bot runtime, and the PR records the policy decision for this exact behavior.
